from datetime import datetime
from collections import defaultdict
users=defaultdict(list)
with open('evidence/log_1.txt') as f:
 for line in f:
  ts,*parts=line.split()
  d=dict(p.split('=',1) for p in parts)
  if d['action']=='login' and d['status']=='fail':
   users[d['user']].append(datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace('Z','+00:00')).timestamp())
print(sum(any(t[i+2]-t[i]<=600 for i in range(len(t)-2)) for t in users.values()))
PY
